description: A through hole in the first of two boxes that already share a contact edge. Both lumps survive with separate edges along the contact.

analytic.counts_differ: Open CASCADE keeps the contact edge and endpoints shared by its two solids. Arris keeps separate copies for each lump.
analytic.occt_odd_euler: The two Open CASCADE solids share one edge and its endpoints.
analytic.occt_step_counts_differ: Open CASCADE writes one copy of the contact edge and endpoints per solid in STEP.
